architecture: Fully convolutional 1D CNN with a CTC output head (no recurrent or attention layers); 5 convolution blocks (Conv1d + BatchNorm + ReLU, dropout 0.05 in training) then a 1x1 Conv1d decoder and log-softmax over blank/A/C/G/T; total stride 3 (one output step per 3 signal samples); receptive field 219 samples (E)
layers_blocks: Conv1d 1→48 k9 stride 3 · 48→104 k13 · 104→80 k27 · 80→64 k25 · 64→48 k9 (each with BatchNorm eps 1e-3 and ReLU) · decoder 48→5 k1; ~445,856 multiply-adds per output step, ~148,600 per input sample; the 104→80 k27 layer is about half the compute (E)
numerical_precision: FP32 weights as supplied (all floating-point tensors FP32, checked E); int8/fixed-point is the project target and quantization is project work (S)
decoder: CTC, no decoder supplied with the model: project implementations of greedy CTC and CTC beam search (fast-ctc-decode, beam 5) (S, E)
framework_runtime: PyTorch 1.10.0 FP32 on the NVIDIA Jetson TX2 GPU (JetPack 4.6.6), verified on D1 and D5 (SOCALL-004, SOCALL-010, SOCALL-011); Apple M2 MPS for the reference pipeline (SOCALL-001/002)
chunk_input_assumptions: 4800 samples, no overlap (supervisor recollection, S); training normalization undocumented, per-read median/MAD works for inference (S, E)
weights_source: Supplied privately by the supervisor (handoff prepared 2026-11-05); not redistributed
limitations: Preliminary reference-accuracy baselines on a laptop (SOCALL-001/002, D5) and on the reflashed TX2 GPU (SOCALL-011, D5, FP32), plus TX2 throughput/power on D1 (SOCALL-003 to 010); greedy only on the TX2, no beam-search run there yet.
Source code and weights are not redistributed; the architecture above is summarized from the supplied model definition so the work can be followed.
Chemistry, sample rate and chunk size come from the supervisor's recollection; training data and normalization are undocumented.
